description.value: Kyuzo is a Japanese restaurant on Granville Street specializing in omakase dining, where the chef curates a personalized meal based on guest preferences and allergies using fresh, seasonal ingredients. The restaurant is notable for offering certified Tajima and Kobe beef sourced from Hyogo Prefecture, Japan. With 85 seats and a transit-accessible location near Oakridge-41st SkyTrain, it offers a full sit-down dining experience in southwest Vancouver.
